dhp179:4:
nessatha → yasya jitaṃ nātha jīyati jitamasya na jināti anhakaඃ 
tambuddhamanantagocaraṃ apadaṃ kena padena neṣyatha. (mahavastu 3. 92 piṭa)
dhp180:4:
nessatha → yasya jālinī visattikā. tṛṣṇā nāsya kahimpi netrikā. 
tambuddhamanantavikramaṃ apadaṃ kena padena neṣyatha. (mahāvastu 3. 92 piṭa)
dhp188:4:
bhayatajjitā → bahavaඃ śaraṇaṃ yānti parvatāṃśava vanāni ca 
ārāmacaitya vākṣāṃśva manuṣyā bhayatarjitāඃ
dhp189:4:
pamuccati → na pabhyataccharaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naitaccharaṇamuttamam 
naitaccharaṇamāgamya sarvaduඃkhāt pramuvyate
dhp190:4:
passati → yasatu buddhaṃ ca dharma ca saṅghaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ gataඃ 
āryyasatyāni catvāri paśyati prajñayā sadā
dhp191:4:
dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ → duඃkhaṃ duඃkhasamutpādaṃ duඃkhasya samatikram 
āryyaṃ cāṣṭāṃgikaṃ mārgaṃ kṣemaṃ nirvāṇagāminam (udānavarga 17 28-31)
dhp192:4:
pamuccati → etaddhiśaraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ etaccharaṇamuttamam 
etaccharaṇamāgamya sarvaduඃkhrān pramucyate (udānavarga 27-31)
dhp193:4:
sukhamedhati → dulībhaඃ puruṣājanyo nāsau sarvatra jāyate. 
yatrāsau jāyate vīraඃ tat kulaṃ sukhamedhate. (mahāvastu 3 109 piṭa) 
dulabho pauruṣa jaño na so sarvatra jayati. 
yatra so jayati viru ta kulu suhumedhati. (prā. dha. C VD 35)
dhp194:4:
sukho → buddhānāṃ sukhamutapādaඃ sukhā dharmasya deśanā 
sukhā saṅghasya sāmagri śramaṇānāṃ tapassukham. (prātimokṣa sūtra 9)
